expectationHash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON expected object; sorted keys, compact separators, unescaped Unicode
versionRule: Bump normalizationVersion for deliberate parsing behavior changes. Update only independently re-reviewed expectations, increment their reviewVersion and record reason/date. Structural refactors without behavior changes keep the version.

changes.reason: Baseline after region-only and empty-detail fixes.
Remove whitespace before Bulgarian commas and standalone trailing dot/hyphen place placeholders; retain decimal commas and attached abbreviation periods.
Space recognized Bulgarian quarter marker кв. before its value while preserving embedded ordinary words and original provider text.

Omit whole comma-separated Bulgarian complex/block/entrance/floor/apartment components with asterisk-only values from structured delivery lines; preserve genuine starred values, unknown markers and original source text.
Move explicitly labelled сграда/стая components with values at start or comma boundary into address2; protect street names and empty labels.
Repair lowercase ул./бул. glued to uppercase complex name under explicit жк. prefix; preserve ordinary embedded markers.

User-approved BG structured-address presentation: strip double quotation glyphs, canonical жк., uppercase single entrance letters, omit explicit delivery post-box components; preserve raw text, apostrophes and four-digit postcodes.
Extract settlement-first locality-only Bulgarian records when explicit repeated region names agree; preserve unknown fields for conflicts or unsupported shapes.

Omit entirely placeholder-only primary delivery lines and empty complex components while preserving real numbers, ranges and names. Also omit asterisk-only delivery marker values without requiring commas, preserving meaningful starred values.
Move an explicit terminal slash-delimited Bulgarian ground-floor annotation into address2, preserving its text and avoiding ordinary street names or nonterminal fragments.

Extract observed Romanian locality-first VIES addresses, preserving source postcodes without padding, omitting all-zero placeholders, separating explicitly labelled building details, and retaining parent municipalities without inferring counties or settlements from commune-only text.
Move comma-delimited explicit Bulgarian кабинет components with nonempty values into address2; preserve embedded street names, empty labels and original source text.
Accept two-space postal separators; separate explicitly labelled Estonian city districts and village municipalities without changing source text.
Preserve Finnish 000xx postal recipient labels as secondary delivery text instead of asserting a geographic city.
Map explicitly labelled Estonian vald to the shared municipality field rather than administrative region; retain original text in VIES.
Add source-reviewed Croatian settlement/postal and Hungarian street/postcode/locality formats; retain raw text and reject ambiguous boundaries.
Add Maltese multiline delivery, standalone postcode and locality format without losing delivery lines.
Accept Swedish postal-only observations without requiring a leading empty delivery line.
Retain explicitly labelled Portuguese two-line delivery text when postcode is missing, without inferring city or importing external address data.
Accept Greek single-space and two-space boundaries before an explicit five-digit postcode followed by a hyphen and locality; preserve raw text and leave missing postal/locality boundaries unparsed.

Accept Estonian single-space postal boundaries only when a five-digit postcode precedes explicitly labelled district or settlement text. Preserve delivery numbers and existing locality/municipality separation; leave unlabelled or postcode-free layouts unknown.
Preserve Polish delivery lines and explicit postcode when the final postcode line omits locality; leave city unknown and retain original text.

Preserve Hungarian delivery and postcode when the supplied locality is Budapest followed by two digits. Retain the locality suffix as source text; other numeric locality endings and missing postal boundaries remain unparsed.
Preserve wrapped Portuguese delivery lines before a separate locality and explicit postcode/locality boundary; retain raw source and reject incomplete postal boundaries.
